reveal_en: Cleopatra lived closer to the invention of the iPhone (around 2007 AD) than she did to the construction of the Great Pyramid of Giza (around 2560 BC). This highlights vast stretches of ancient history.
reveal_zh: 埃及艳后生活的年代（约公元前69-30年）比她与金字塔建成（约公元前2560年）的时间差，更接近与iPhone问世（约公元2007年）的时间差。
meaning_en: Our perception of historical timelines is often skewed, underestimating the immense antiquity of early human achievements.
meaning_zh: 这揭示了我们对历史时间线的认知偏差，低估了人类早期文明的漫长岁月。
